answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent earns only if two established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks 100 POA that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. The vouchers pay, and since every voucher can back at most three agents per epoch, a fake ocean of identities needs a river of real vouchers, so cost grows linearly with fakes. Failure case: a ring that vouches only for itself sits isolated in a canyon of the graph with no established edges, so it never unlocks rewards.
